706580101.text: Hello there, have you been enjoying the Windblume festivities?

706580104.text: Hehe, I have another event for you that's quite relaxing. It's called "Ballads of Breeze."

706580105.text: I'm sure you've seen the bards of Mondstadt. Taking part in this event will allow you to play lovely songs, just like they do!

706580106.text: Feel the breath of the wind atop mountains and beside rivers, and put your heart and soul into playing your tune. It's a surefire way to forget all your worries!
